title: Sexuality, chastity and same-sex attraction
tagline: What chastity is for, what the Church teaches about same-sex attraction, and how to talk about it with friends with truth and love.
whyItMatters: Teaching on the body can sound like a list of no's. Chastity is the Church's name for loving rightly, and every person, whatever their attractions, is called to it and to be treated with respect.

mindset.tip: Treat persons as persons. The Catechism says persons with same-sex tendencies must be accepted with respect, compassion and sensitivity (CCC 2358).
Listen to people who live this teaching, not only to people who write about it.
Do not begin with prohibitions. Begin with what the body and sex are for: a gift of self (Theology of the Body).
Admit that the teaching is hard and that the Church's own people have sometimes spoken badly. Apologise where it is owed.
Know that many friends will hear this as rejection. Stay a friend; friendship is itself part of the Church's answer (CCC 2359).
